Threat_Vector_CVE: Exploitation of unauthenticated remote connection or buffer overflow on UPS network card (CVE-2022-22805 / TLStorm or CVE-2025-46412). MITRE T0812 - Command Injection.
Operational_Safety_Consequence: Malicious firmware update or command execution causes modular UPS systems to bypass online double-conversion, dropping the critical load. This immediately trips downstream PDUs and blackouts the server hall.
IEC_62443_Mitigations: SR 1.1 RE(2): Enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all administration networks; SR 3.4 RE(1): Cryptographic verification of all firmware updates.
Compensating_Physical_Controls: Hardwired manual maintenance bypass switches physically locked with strict key-custody controls, bypassing the network interface entirely.

Threat_Vector_CVE: Command injection via Modbus TCP (Port 502) to ASCO 5310/5350 controller (CVE-2025-1058 / CVE-2025-1060). MITRE T0843 - Program Upload/Download.
Operational_Safety_Consequence: Forcing an out-of-phase power transfer between the utility grid and backup diesel generators. This causes catastrophic torque spikes, destroying generator drive-shafts and creating a massive fire hazard in the generator yard.
IEC_62443_Mitigations: SR 5.2: Isolate ATS control communications within a dedicated, firewalled Electrical Safety Zone; SR 3.1 RE(1): Enforce cryptographic integrity protection on all local control networks.
Compensating_Physical_Controls: Install mechanical sync-check relays (e.g., SEL-547) that physically block contacts from closing unless phase angle, voltage, and frequency are synchronized, overriding any malicious software signal.

Physical_Process_Deviation: Loss of Flow / Thermal Runaway (Chiller Trip)
Threat_Vector_CVE: Exploitation of unauthenticated remote execution vulnerability in Johnson Controls Metasys (CVE-2025-26385) or Honeywell Niagara Framework (CVE-2025-3936). MITRE T0827 - Impair Process Control.
Operational_Safety_Consequence: Manipulation of motorized isolation valves (FCV-FWS-01) or primary chilled water pumps to force closed-loop stagnation. Chillers trip on high evaporator pressure, initiating rapid thermal runaway in the data halls, leading to automatic thermal shutdown of IT gear within 120 seconds.
IEC_62443_Mitigations: SR 5.1 RE(2): Establish complete logical and physical independence of the BMS network from corporate IT systems; SR 3.2 RE(2): Enforce application whitelisting on Metasys/Niagara supervisory servers to prevent unauthorized process execution.
Compensating_Physical_Controls: Install mechanical differential pressure relief bypass valves that open automatically under pressure spikes, maintaining minimal flow even if digital control valves are maliciously commanded shut.

Threat_Vector_CVE: Unauthorized modification of PID loop setpoints on Woodward RX3i CDU controller. MITRE T0836 - Modify Parameter.
Operational_Safety_Consequence: CDU-PLC cooling water control valves (FCV-FWS) are forced 100% open. The secondary loop temperature drops below the dew point of the server hall, creating condensation across high-density liquid-cooled GPU nodes, triggering short-circuits and permanent component destruction.
IEC_62443_Mitigations: SR 2.1 RE(2): Map permissions strictly to technical roles; ensure the cooling team has no write-back authorization to power or network systems; SR 1.2: Enforce unique cryptographic device-to-device authentication (using certificates) between CDU-PLCs and the BMS head-end.
Compensating_Physical_Controls: Implement hardwired thermal limit switches in the secondary supply loop that physically cut power to the primary FWS control valve if the fluid temperature drops below 20°C.

Threat_Vector_CVE: Man-in-the-middle or replay attack over unencrypted physical OSDP connections to HID Mercury controllers. MITRE T0811 - Data Line Spoofing.
Operational_Safety_Consequence: Attackers spoof credential authentication responses on the RS-485 line, unlocking secure man-traps and restricting physical access control to key data hall infrastructure, enabling physical tampering or local console access to engineering workstations (EWS).
IEC_62443_Mitigations: SR 5.2: Enforce boundary protection on all communication ports.
Compensating_Physical_Controls: Upgrade all card readers and controllers to utilize OSDP v2 with Secure Channel (AES-128 encryption) to protect communication integrity across physical cables. Deploy redundant visual verification (24/7 CCTV analytical analytics cross-referenced with badge events).

Threat_Vector_CVE: Delivery of physical controller (e.g., ABB AC500 V3) containing a pre-installed hardware backdoor or compromised firmware with hidden logic modification (CVE-2025-2595 / CVE-2025-41659). MITRE T0862 - Supply Chain Compromise.
Operational_Safety_Consequence: The compromised controller executes a localized 'stuxnet-style' sabotage campaign, fluctuating cooling tower fan speeds to induce physical harmonic fatigue and mechanical failure while reporting false 'normal' telemetry to the BMS SCADA.
IEC_62443_Mitigations: SR 7.8: Maintain a continuous, cryptographically verified asset inventory mapping hardware/software components directly back to original manufacturers.
Compensating_Physical_Controls: Implement a Zero Trust Supply Chain Model requiring all component suppliers to undergo third-party auditing (IEC 62443-4-1 or SDLA). Mandate cryptographic hash validation of all vendor-supplied logic before commissioning.
